cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dinner's at seven from now on. I kept it warm until eleven again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My battery died. I couldn't call.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was the train; same ruined dinner. I'll put your plate in the fridge, but I won't wait up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone. Can't you keep it warm?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's me waiting again. I'll show you how to reheat it. Miss another call and you're doing next week's cooking.

reason: Give A a workable saved-plate and reheating concession while interpreting B renewed warm-meal request as the same pattern and raising the consequence to cooking duty.
